data.exact_reserve_text: During the year, the Syndicate released GBP 10.1m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2016: GBP 2.6m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class (2016: predominantly from the nuclear liability class).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a prior-year reserve release of GBP 10.1m in 2017, arising predominantly from the nuclear property class. This release reduced gross claims outstanding relative to the opening reserves and is described in the movement note as a favourable development on prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: released GBP 10.1m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2016: GBP 2.6m) arising predominantly from the nuclear property class (2016: predominantly from the nuclear liability class).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, 2016 column). Prior year development sourced from Note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states a GBP 10.1m release (treated as gross). LOB mapping of 'nuclear property' => Property and 'nuclear liability' => Casualty inferred from class descriptions. Claims development triangle present but some cell values in the scanned image were difficult to read; triangle transcription is therefore approximate and used only as supplementary information.
